# Vendored zstd (decompress only)

`zstddeclib.c` is upstream zstd **1.5.7**, generated by facebook/zstd's own
`build/single_file_libs/create_single_file_decoder.sh`. It is the decompressor only — a device
never compresses — which keeps it to one file and a small binary.

Apple's Compression framework has no zstd, so without this iOS could not read the wire format
Android and the CLI already speak. The alternatives were a second codec for iOS only (a ~29%
larger payload, two code paths, and a complication for the planned bytecode deltas) or a
third-party pod (supply chain risk in a library whose job is verifying signatures).

Pinned to 1.5.7 to match `zstd-jni:1.5.7-4` on Android, so both platforms decode frames from the
same encoder version.

Licensed BSD-3-Clause or GPLv2 at your option; this project selects BSD-3-Clause. `LICENSE` is the
upstream BSD text.

**To update:** re-run the upstream generator against the new tag, replace `zstddeclib.c`, `zstd.h`
and `zstd_errors.h`, and bump the version above. Do not hand-edit these files.
